newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico January maquiladora employment jumps.
newsitem.headline: Mexico January maquiladora employment jumps.

text.p: Employment in Mexico's maquiladora export sector rose 18.2 percent in January this year compared to the same month a year earlier, the government's statistics agency said on Wednesday.
The National Statistics, Geography and Information Institute said employment in the sector reached 818,062 people in the month.
In the first month of the year, five border states captured 81.3 percent of the industry. They were Chihuahua, Baja California, Tamaulipas, Coahuila and Sonora.
Of those employed in the maquiladora export industry, 81.5 percent were workers, 11.2 percent production technicians, and 7.3 percent administrative personal.
